recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片正中央有一個巨核細胞，細胞質豐富粉紅，但細胞核分成四個彼此完全分離的圓形小核（separated nuclear lobes），是 MDS 典型的巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Nucleus divided into four widely separated, round, non-connected lobes
Individual lobes small with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Surrounding hematopoietic cells include erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells
Adjacent fat space; background marrow cellular
describe_en: High-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow trephine shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multiple (four) widely separated, round nuclear lobes that are not connected to one another. The surrounding marrow contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors. This separated-lobe ("pawn ball") megakaryocyte is a characteristic dysplastic form and, together with other dysplastic features and increased blasts, supports myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Occasional multinucleated megakaryocytes can be reactive, but they are infrequent and lack the accompanying multilineage dysplasia and clonal abnormalities of MDS.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated but connected (staghorn) or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei rather than discrete separated round lobes.
Osteoclasts lie along bone surfaces and contain many uniform, evenly distributed nuclei, whereas megakaryocytes lie in the marrow space and are CD61 positive.
